entity.tesla_tycoon.gotiya_monster_truck: Seth Gotiya's Rival Diesel Monster Truck
item.tesla_tycoon.gotiya_monster_truck_s: Seth Gotiya's Rival Diesel Monster Truck (park it)
entity.tesla_tycoon.gotiya_truck: Seth Gotiya's Rival Diesel Monster Truck
upgrade.tesla_tycoon.hydraulics.desc: Counter to Gotiya's road spikes. SPACE makes any car hop, and armored tires crush the spikes instead of puncturing.
upgrade.tesla_tycoon.level2.desc: Adds a glass floor. The Model 3 (Autopilot Sedan) takes the ground floor; the Classic Compact moves up.
upgrade.tesla_tycoon.solar.desc: Counter to the blackout: brings the neon back and adds solar panels and MegaPacks.
upgrade.tesla_tycoon.level3.desc: Adds a glass floor and unlocks the Armored Cybertruck.
upgrade.tesla_tycoon.ram.desc: Counter to Gotiya's roadblocks: press V in the Cybertruck, then smash 2 concrete roadblocks.
upgrade.tesla_tycoon.level4.desc: Adds a glass floor, the Robotaxi Terminal and 4 autonomous Cybercabs that loop the whole city and carry passengers between the sidewalk stations.
upgrade.tesla_tycoon.starlink.desc: Part 1 of the GPS counter: a dish on the roof.
upgrade.tesla_tycoon.billboards.desc: Part 2 of the GPS counter: right-click empty billboards on the highway turns around the city to run the Anant Tesla ad (+6% income each, 3 needed).
upgrade.tesla_tycoon.level5.desc: The finale: unlocks the Flying SpaceX Roadster on the rooftop helipad, the lobby launch pad and the EMP shockwave (R).
upgrade.tesla_tycoon.posters.desc: Four wall posters to decorate the showroom walls and glass pillars.
screen.tesla_tycoon.shop_sub: Buy counters to Seth Gotiya's sabotage, upgrade the showroom floor by floor
hud.tesla_tycoon.shop_hint: Press B (or use the Depot Terminal) to buy!
hud.tesla_tycoon.guide_title: GUIDE  -  press Right Shift to hide
hud.tesla_tycoon.fly: SPACE thrusters  |  CTRL descend  |  mouse: pitch + yaw
hud.tesla_tycoon.sabotage.1: GOTIYA'S ROAD SPIKES on the road!
hud.tesla_tycoon.sabotage.2: GOTIYA CUT THE POWER! Neon is dead
hud.tesla_tycoon.counter.2: Buy the Tesla Solar Roof + MegaPack (B)
hud.tesla_tycoon.counter.3: Buy Beast Ram Mode, then smash 2 roadblocks with the Cybertruck (V)
hud.tesla_tycoon.counter.4: Buy the Starlink dish + Billboard pack, then put up 3 billboards
hud.tesla_tycoon.sabotage.5: MONSTER TRUCK ATTACK ON THE SHOWROOM!
hud.tesla_tycoon.counter.5: Fly the Roadster: SPACE thrusters, then R = EMP on the truck
hud.tesla_tycoon.alarm.gate: SECURITY ALARM - GOTIYA IS RAMMING THE GATE!
hud.tesla_tycoon.alarm.attack: MONSTER TRUCK ATTACK - FLY THE ROADSTER, PRESS R
hud.tesla_tycoon.alarm.hint1: Step on the glowing launch pad in the lobby: it takes you to the roof.
hud.tesla_tycoon.alarm.hint2: Right-click the red Roadster, SPACE = thrusters, R = EMP the truck.
